title: Resident Evil
overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: Mek in mek
overview: Facing financial trouble, an obscure singer with a talent for impersonation teams up with his friends to perform as a double of pop star Arkadi Dumikyan at private events. Chaos ensues when the real singer discovers someone else is touring under his name.
